placements.title: E2E Test Suites Enforce Automatic Reviewer Enrollment for Memory Creators
placements.frame: How does the e2e test suite verify and enforce that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer?
placements.why: src-1 records the decision that the e2e suite asserts automatic creator reviewer enrollment upon saving a memory, and src-2 confirms the probe memory exists to carry that test assertion.
